// Uses of Dialog: screens of the first corpus and blocks of the notation reference that write it,
// taken by tool/dictionary_closure.dart --harvest (the most shapes of it first). Do not edit: run it again.
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/2026-11-16-sonnet/answers/mail-client.txt ### Compose
state to=[]
state toText=""
state subject=""
state bodyText=""
state attachments=[]
state discardAsk=false
Dialog#compose "New message" onClose={bodyText!="" || subject!="" || length(to)>0 ? open keepDraft : close} resizable maxw=640
  Column gap=8
    ChipInput "To" @to text=toText suggestions={filter(contacts, c => toText!="" && (contains(lower(c.name),lower(toText)) || contains(lower(c.email),lower(toText))) && !contains(to,c.email))} suggestionLabel="{item.name}" suggestionHint="{item.email}" separators=",; " validate=email onInvalid={toast "Not a valid address"}
    Input "Subject" @subject
    Input "Message" multiline @bodyText minLines=10 initial="\n\n-- \n{signature}"
    Row gap=8 scroll visible={length(attachments)>0}
      each a in attachments
        AttachmentTile "{a.name}" subtitle="{a.size}" icon="description" removable onRemove={attachments=without(attachments,a)}
    Row between middle
      Row gap=8
        Button "Send" icon="send" disabled={length(to)==0} onTap={emit send {"to":to,"subject":subject,"body":bodyText}; to=[]; subject=""; bodyText=""; attachments=[]; close; toast "Message sent"}
        FilePicker "Attach" icon="attach_file" multiple onPick={attachments=concat(attachments,result)}
      IconButton "delete" tooltip="Discard" onTap={open keepDraft}
Dialog#keepDraft "Keep this draft?" "You have text that has not been sent."
  Row end gap=8
    Button.ghost "Discard" onTap={to=[]; subject=""; bodyText=""; attachments=[]; close; close compose; toast "Draft discarded"}
    Button.outline "Keep editing" onTap={close}
    Button "Save draft" onTap={emit saveDraft {"to":to,"subject":subject,"body":bodyText}; to=[]; subject=""; bodyText=""; attachments=[]; close; close compose; toast "Draft saved"}
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/2026-11-16-sonnet/answers/notes-app.txt ### Search
state pq=""
state pcursor=0
Dialog#palette "" top w=560
  Input "Search notes, notebooks, actions" @pq autofocus icon="search" onChange={pcursor=0} onKeyDown={key=="ArrowDown"?pcursor=pcursor+1:(key=="ArrowUp"?pcursor=max(0,pcursor-1):pcursor=pcursor)}
  CommandList query={pq} @pcursor fuzzy highlight onEnter={emit paletteRun result} onPick={close}
    Group "Notes"
      each n in filter(notes,x=>!x.trashed)
        CommandItem "{n.title}" hint="{first(map(filter(notebooks,b=>b.id==n.nb),b=>b.name))}" icon="description" keywords="{n.body} {join(n.tags," ")}" onTap={openId=n.id; view="workspace"; pane="note"; close}
    Group "Notebooks"
      each b in notebooks
        CommandItem "{b.name}" icon="folder" onTap={nb=b.id; view="workspace"; pane="list"; close}
    Group "Actions"
      CommandItem "New note" icon="add" shortcut="Ctrl N" onTap={emit newNote; close}
      CommandItem "Open settings" icon="settings" onTap={view="settings"; close}
      CommandItem "Open trash" icon="delete" onTap={view="trash"; close}
      CommandItem "Toggle dark theme" icon="dark_mode" onTap={theme=theme=="Dark"?"Paper":"Dark"; close}
    EmptyState "No matches" icon="search_off"
  Row between pad=8
    Text.caption "Up and down to move, Enter to open, Esc to close"
    Text.caption "{length(notes)} notes"
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/2026-11-16-sonnet/answers/calendar-app.txt ### Month
state view="month" persist
state hiddenCals=[] persist
state cursor=today()
state mini=today()
state q=""
state cals=[{"id":"work","name":"Work","color":"#FF2563EB"},{"id":"home","name":"Home","color":"#FF16A34A"},{"id":"family","name":"Family","color":"#FFDB2777"},{"id":"health","name":"Health","color":"#FFEA580C"},{"id":"travel","name":"Travel","color":"#FF7C3AED"},{"id":"focus","name":"Focus","color":"#FF0891B2"}]
state events=[{"id":1,"title":"Sprint planning","cal":"work","start":"2026-11-16","end":"2026-11-16","from":"09:30","to":"10:30","allDay":false,"repeat":"Weekly","guests":["Priya","Tom"],"note":""},{"id":2,"title":"Dentist","cal":"health","start":"2026-11-17","end":"2026-11-17","from":"14:00","to":"15:00","allDay":false,"repeat":"Never","guests":[],"note":"Bring insurance card"},{"id":3,"title":"Lisbon trip","cal":"travel","start":"2026-11-20","end":"2026-11-24","from":"","to":"","allDay":true,"repeat":"Never","guests":["Sam"],"note":"Flight TP 207"},{"id":4,"title":"Deep work","cal":"focus","start":"2026-11-16","end":"2026-11-16","from":"13:00","to":"15:30","allDay":false,"repeat":"Daily","guests":[],"note":""},{"id":5,"title":"Mum's birthday","cal":"family","start":"2026-11-18","end":"2026-11-18","from":"","to":"","allDay":true,"repeat":"Yearly","guests":[],"note":""},{"id":6,"title":"Boiler service","cal":"home","start":"2026-11-19","end":"2026-11-19","from":"08:00","to":"10:00","allDay":false,"repeat":"Never","guests":[],"note":""}]
state draft={"id":0,"title":"","cal":"work","start":"","end":"","from":"09:00","to":"10:00","allDay":false,"repeat":"Never","guests":[],"note":""}
state guestInput=""
state sel=0
state selDay=""
state visible=[]
shortcut key=t onPress={cursor=today(); mini=today()}
shortcut key=n onPress={draft=with(with(draft,"start",cursor),"end",cursor); open event}
shortcut key=m onPress={view="month"}
shortcut key=w onPress={view="week"}
shortcut key=d onPress={view="day"}
shortcut key=a onPress={view="agenda"}
shortcut key=k onPress={go search}
shortcut key=j onPress={cursor=addDays(cursor,view=="month"?30:view=="week"?7:1)}
shortcut key=ArrowRight onPress={cursor=addDays(cursor,1)}
shortcut key=ArrowLeft onPress={cursor=addDays(cursor,-1)}
shortcut key=ArrowDown onPress={cursor=addDays(cursor,7)}
shortcut key=ArrowUp onPress={cursor=addDays(cursor,-7)}
shortcut key=Enter onPress={selDay=cursor; open dayEvents}
App
  Sidebar w=260
    Brand "Margin" icon="calendar_month"
    Button "New event" icon="add" onTap={draft=with(with(draft,"start",cursor),"end",cursor); open event}
    MiniCalendar @mini value={cursor} marks={map(events,e=>e.start)} onSelect={cursor=result; mini=result}
    Text.fieldLabel "Calendars"
    each c in cals
      Row gap=8 middle
        Box w=10 h=10 radius=5 fill={c.color}
        Text.body c.name grow
        Toggle @c.show value={!contains(hiddenCals,c.id)} onChange={hiddenCals=result?without(hiddenCals,c.id):append(hiddenCals,c.id)}
    Spacer grow
    NavItem "Search" icon="search" onTap={go search}
    NavItem "Manage calendars" icon="palette" onTap={go calendars}
  Main
    Nav border-bottom=#FFE5E7EB
      Row gap=8 middle
        IconButton "chevron_left" onTap={cursor=addDays(cursor,view=="month"?-30:view=="week"?-7:-1)}
        Button.outline "Today" onTap={cursor=today()}
        IconButton "chevron_right" onTap={cursor=addDays(cursor,view=="month"?30:view=="week"?7:1)}
        Heading "{formatDate(cursor,'MMMM yyyy')}" level=2
      Row gap=8 middle
        Input "Search" "Find events" icon="search" @q w=200 hide=phone onSubmit={go search}
        Tabs @view items=["month","week","day","agenda"] labels=["Month","Week","Day","Agenda"] shortcuts=["m","w","d","a"]
    Column pad=16 gap=0 grow
      Row stretch
        each d in ["Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun"]
          Text.caption d grow center
      MonthGrid value={cursor} weekStart=1 today={today()} showWeekNumbers=true onMove={cursor=result}
        cell day
          Column gap=2 pad=4 border=#FFE5E7EB tap-target
            Text "{formatDate(day.date,'d')}" tabular weight={day.isToday?700:400} color={day.isToday?"#FFFFFFFF":"#FF111827"} fill={day.isToday?"#FF2563EB":"transparent"} radius=12 onTap={cursor=day.date; selDay=day.date; open dayEvents}
            each e in take(filter(events,x=>x.start<=day.date&&x.end>=day.date&&!contains(hiddenCals,x.cal)),3)
              Row gap=4 middle fill={find(cals,c=>c.id==e.cal).color} radius=4 pad=[4,1,4,1] onTap={draft=e; open event}
                Text.caption e.title color=#FFFFFFFF
            if count(events,x=>x.start<=day.date&&x.end>=day.date&&!contains(hiddenCals,x.cal))>3
              Text.caption "+{count(events,x=>x.start<=day.date&&x.end>=day.date&&!contains(hiddenCals,x.cal))-3} more" onTap={selDay=day.date; open dayEvents}
  Dialog#dayEvents "{formatDate(selDay,'EEEE, MMM d')}"
    if count(events,x=>x.start<=selDay&&x.end>=selDay&&!contains(hiddenCals,x.cal))==0
      EmptyState "No events" "Nothing planned for this day." icon="event_available"
    each e in sortBy(filter(events,x=>x.start<=selDay&&x.end>=selDay&&!contains(hiddenCals,x.cal)),x=>x.from)
      ListTile e.title subtitle={e.allDay?"All day":"{e.from} - {e.to}"} leading={find(cals,c=>c.id==e.cal).color} onTap={draft=e; close; open event}
    Button "Add event" icon="add" onTap={draft=with(with(draft,"start",selDay),"end",selDay); close; open event}
  Dialog#event "{draft.id==0?'New event':'Edit event'}" persistent
    Column gap=12
      Input "Title" "Add a title" @draft.title autofocus
      Row gap=8 middle
        Select "Calendar" @draft.cal items={map(cals,c=>c.id)} labels={map(cals,c=>c.name)} dots={map(cals,c=>c.color)} grow
        Toggle "All day" @draft.allDay
      DateRangePicker "Dates" start=draft.start end=draft.end onChange={draft=with(with(draft,"start",result.start),"end",result.end)}
      if draft.end<draft.start
        Text.danger "End must not be before start."
      if !draft.allDay
        Row gap=8
          TimePicker "Starts" @draft.from grow
          TimePicker "Ends" @draft.to grow
        if draft.start==draft.end&&draft.to<=draft.from
          Text.danger "End time must be after start time."
      SegmentedButton "Repeat" @draft.repeat items=["Never","Daily","Weekly","Monthly"]
      Column gap=6
        Text.fieldLabel "Guests"
        Row gap=6 wrap
          each g in draft.guests
            Chip g onDelete={draft=with(draft,"guests",without(draft.guests,g))}
        Input "Add guest" "Name or email" @guestInput onSubmit={draft=with(draft,"guests",append(draft.guests,guestInput)); guestInput=""}
      Input "Note" multiline @draft.note
      Row between
        if draft.id!=0
          Button.destructive "Delete" onTap={open confirmDelete}
        Spacer grow
        Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
        Button "Save" disabled={draft.title==""||draft.end<draft.start||(!draft.allDay&&draft.start==draft.end&&draft.to<=draft.from)} onTap={events=draft.id==0?append(events,with(draft,"id",length(events)+1)):updateWhere(events,x=>x.id==draft.id,x=>draft); toast "Saved"; close}
  Dialog#confirmDelete "Delete this event?" "This cannot be undone."
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Keep" onTap={close}
      Button.destructive "Delete" onTap={events=removeWhere(events,x=>x.id==draft.id); toast "Event deleted"; close; close}
